description.value: Anavada Inn & Suites is a recently renovated budget motel in Prince George, BC, offering straightforward rooms with kitchenettes, mini-fridges, and a community kitchen available to all guests. The property features an on-site Mexican restaurant, CHACO'S, making it convenient for a sit-down evening meal without leaving the premises. It is pet-friendly and centrally located with 24-hour front desk reception.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an operational motel at 1391 Central St W, Prince George, BC matching the OSM address and phone number. No bike-specific storage or cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere on the site; 'secure parking monitored 24/7' refers to vehicle parking. Laundry facilities and Wi-Fi are explicitly listed in room amenities, and an on-site restaurant (CHACO'S) is confirmed for the Prince George location.
concerns: OSM name includes 'Spruceland' (likely the neighbourhood name) but the business's own website uses only 'Anavada Inn & Suites' or 'Anavada Inn & Suites Prince George' — 'Spruceland' does not appear on the website.
OSM email (info@anavadainn.ca) differs from the contact page email shown on the website (reservations@anavadainn.ca).

Website front page mentions 'complimentary breakfast' for both locations, but the Prince George-specific room details page does not list breakfast as an amenity — breakfast availability at the Prince George location is unconfirmed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible motel with a confirmed address, phone, and active website. Useful to touring cyclists as an overnight accommodation option in Prince George.

Laundry.detail: Guest Laundry listed in room amenities for Prince George location (charges apply)

Nearby evening food.detail: CHACO'S on-site restaurant at the Prince George location serves tacos, pizza, and margaritas
